title: VisCodeBench: a new benchmark dataset for Text-to-Vis reflecting real-world practice
abstract: arXiv:2611.02353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating visualisations from natural language requests (text-to-vis) enables users to explore data more efficiently. While LLMs can complete simple visualisation requests, their performance on challenging ones is not well covered by existing benchmarks. We introduce VisCodeBench, an end-to-end text-to-vis benchmark with 2,672 samples from three different domains: educational, scientific, and general audience scenarios with varying levels of complexity. We benchmark three visualisation systems---Codex, Claude Code, and LIDA---paired with a range of open and commercial LLMs across seven metrics covering execution, chart content, and visual quality. While basic execution is near-solved for strong systems, no system comes close to reproducing the reference data, with the best displayed data similarity reaching only $0.81$ and falling to $0.69$ on our hardest subset for this metric. translated_title: VisCodeBench：一个反映真实世界实践的文本到可视化新基准数据集
translated_abstract: 从自然语言请求生成可视化（文本到可视化）使用户能够更高效地探索数据。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）能够完成简单的可视化请求，但现有基准数据集并未充分覆盖它们在具有挑战性的请求上的表现。我们推出了VisCodeBench，这是一个端到端的文本到可视化基准数据集，包含来自教育、科学和大众受众三个不同领域的2,672个样本，复杂程度各不相同。我们在涵盖执行、图表内容和视觉质量的七项指标上，对三种可视化系统——Codex、Claude Code和LIDA——搭配一系列开源和商业LLM进行了基准测试。结果表明，虽然对于强大的系统而言，基本执行已接近解决，但没有任何系统能够接近复现参考数据，最佳显示数据相似度仅为0.81，在最难的数据子集上更是降至0.69。我们进一步发现，前沿模型在图表内容（原文截断）方面表现出明显分化。
tldr: 该论文提出VisCodeBench，一个包含2,672个来自教育、科学和大众受众领域样本的端到端文本到可视化基准数据集，评估发现现有LLM可视化系统虽能基本成功执行代码，但在复现参考数据方面表现不佳，最佳数据相似度仅为0.81。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces VisCodeBench, an end-to-end text-to-vis benchmark with 2,672 samples from educational, scientific, and general audience domains, revealing that although current LLM-based visualization systems nearly solve basic code execution, they fall far short of reproducing reference data, with the best displayed data similarity reaching only 0.81.
